reviews.comment: Amanda was great with MATH140. I took a synchronous online course and she made it very interesting. Great at explaining things to everyone. Be sure to go to every class online just as you would in person.

Professor Hoisington is great! I had an online morning class and it was a great way to start the day. She's very cheerful and responds very quickly if you have any questions. The tests aren't too bad if you study, and there is group work almost every week which can be great if your group does their fair share. Just go to lectures and you're golden.

Professor Hoisington was a great professor! Shes very sweet and she accommodated with people when they needed it. She extended our deadlines a lot when it was necessary. Downsides I would say are that she gives a ton of group work, takes a long time to grade, and her exams were not time friendly sometimes. Very sweet Professor though!

I thoroughly enjoyed her class. She makes math less painful. However, the outline for the class could use some work, the exams arent the most time friendly. There is a lot of homework and a lot of group work. But she will extend deadlines for homework for certain instances.

Amanda is a great prof, but Math 140 is far and away the worst course I have ever taken in my four years of undergrad. It is legitimately the biggest waste of time and is without a doubt the worst structured course I have ever taken. It treats students like 5th graders and is a massive time consumer for no reason. Take this at a CC if you can.

She's an amazing professor. She really cares about her students and wants everyone to do well. She's willing to meet outside of class, no matter what time of day. I once had to meet with her at 9pm for homework help because I had work and she was very willing to do that. She does reviews before every test and if you complete those, you'll pass!

Personally Im terrible at math! This course however is possible to pass with this prof. She is very encouraging and explains the topics well enough that even I managed to pass. Go to the office hours! Ask questions!

One of the nicest professors you will ever meet. However, do not take her class! My whole class was forced into her class so we did not choose her. She literally took 1 month to put our test grades in. Every other prof for Math 150 gave practice tests so it was easy to make an A on the test. But SHE did not. So i made a C.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Amanda definitely enjoys teaching and cares about her students. That being said, she takes forever to grade tests (usually 2 weeks), isn't great about responding to emails, and would often forget to give the TA's the group quizzes to work out beforehand until right before the quiz. The class wasn't too bad, but I'd recommend a more organized prof.

Amanda is a sweet professor and will definitely prepare you for future calculus classes. Material is rushed, and the lecture times arent sufficient. Use her office hours as much as possible. However she takes an eternity to grade, which leaves you in the dark for most of the semester on your stature in the class.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: One of the best teacher I've ever had. She goes through the material pretty fast, but always stops to answer any questions. She wants you to succeed and will help you until you understand the material. She is very caring and will stay past her office hours to help you out. The test are difficult, but if you do her test reviews you should be fine.

Amanda is such a sweet professor. Shes patient in class and made it clear she's always available outside of class to provide help. She can be kind of slow though, as it took her several weeks to grade tests and we were always a little behind schedule in lecture. Recitation is a group worksheet. She's the perfect professor if you struggle with Math.
